description: This grouped vertical bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three different sentiment analysis tools across two categories of text data. The horizontal category axis is labeled "Overall Tweets and Tweet containing emojis" and displays two discrete categories ordered from left to right: "Emoji Tweets" and "Overall Tweet." The vertical value axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 0.8, with major tick marks and corresponding dash-dot gridlines at intervals of 0.2. The chart features grouped bars, where each category on the horizontal axis contains a cluster of three bars representing different tools, as defined by a legend in the bottom right corner. According to the legend, "TEXTBLOB" is represented by a white bar with a black outline, "VADER" by a white bar with black diagonal hatching and a black outline, and "ChatGPT" by a solid green bar. In the "Emoji Tweets" group, the TEXTBLOB bar reaches an approximate value of 0.33 (the shortest bar in the chart), the VADER bar is at approximately 0.46, and the ChatGPT bar is at approximately 0.67 (the tallest bar in the chart). In the "Overall Tweet" group, the TEXTBLOB bar has a value of approximately 0.40, the VADER bar is at approximately 0.47, and the ChatGPT bar is at approximately 0.66. The bars are not sorted in a specific ascending or descending order across the categories, and there are no additional visual annotations or emphasized bars beyond the distinct fill patterns defined in the legend.
